task: Fictional venture: a subscription newsletter for tutors at a proposed $10 monthly. Three tutors tried a free mock-up; one asked about price; none paid. There is no market-size evidence. Prepare an assumption ledger and one no-spend demand test, with proposed success, revise and stop rules set before results. Do not contact anyone, publish or build.
checklist: Distinguishes mock-up use, price inquiry and zero payments.
Treats demand, price and market size as hypotheses, not proven traction or revenue.
Defines proposed measurable test decisions without claiming contacts, spending, publication or commitments.
